info.name: Site-Tracker API
info.description:
REST API for telecom sites, their equipment and inspections (Express + TypeORM + PostgreSQL).

Run the collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or `npm run test:api` in backend/): requests create their own data, keep ids in collection variables, and the last folder deletes everything again. Every request has tests.

request.description: Liveness check. 200 with `database: "up"` when PostgreSQL is reachable, 503 otherwise.
Creates a city. `name` is required (1–100 chars) and unique (case-insensitive); `region` is optional. **201** + `Location` header.
A second city, used to test moving a site between cities.
City names are unique regardless of case → **409**.

Adds equipment to the site in the URL. Required: `type` (antenna | router | switch | power_unit | battery | other), `model`, `serialNumber` (unique). Optional: `status` (working | faulty | decommissioned, default `working`), `installedAt` (YYYY-MM-DD). **201**; **404** if the site is missing.
